High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[What Is Thy Bidding, My Master? (Decipher Errata 2002)]] (the card with its Decipher errata text and the errata mark) (Dagobah, Light Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Light_E/What Is They Bidding My Master _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SssI2eKZNknKg7NYJTYqXvD-OM3JAiBo/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>What Is They Bidding My Master _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,341,224 bytes, SHA-256 <code>5016a0c12b7036e9db7541eafdea185c03cc98e9a91ad960a2298898e06be5e4</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 44.0, 47.5, 72.5, 57.0 px); resized: no; no other change.

The regular face of this card on its article stays [[:File:Dagobah-L-whatisthybiddingmymaster.gif]]; this file is shown there as the High-Res Scan.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project.
